newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: SOCCER-TWO HAT-TRICKS AS BRUGES TRIUMPH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO HAT-TRICKS AS BRUGES TRIUMPH.

text.p: Five first half goals from Club Bruges, including a hat-trick by Lorenzo Staelens, saw the Belgian side beat HIT Gorica 5-3 in the UEFA Cup second preliminary round, first leg on Tuesday.
Milan Osterc made the score sheet three times for Gorica to give the Slovenians hope for the second leg.

Gert Claessens started the scoring for Bruges after 11 minutes and Staelens was on target two minutes later from a penalty. Staelens added his second in the 21st minute while Claessens followed suit five minutes later before completing his hat-trick with another penalty two minutes before the break.
Gorica stepped up a gear in the second half and Osterc scored in the 62nd, 64th and 83rd minutes.
